name: Anna Rudina
tagline:
Good content is idea + structure + emotion.

I plan, shoot and design — from product listings to a brand's social media.
about:
**Hi! My name is Anna.** I'm a digital media student in Seoul and a freelance designer with 5+ years of experience. I create ==visual content, social media and presentations== that communicate a brand's message.

I currently work as a Marketing Manager Assistant at **Bueno Bio**: I run three SNS channels, design A+ content and product pages for Amazon and YesStyle, shoot reels and collaborate with influencers.

I speak Russian, English and Korean, so I can build content for several markets at once. I love K-beauty, culture and life in Korea.
